items.title: "Papa Jack" Laine, Mrs. "Papa Jack" Laine and Johnny Wiggs Interview, 1959-02-27
items.q: So we got one for Merritt and one for Abby and one I sent Georgie.

ctx.x: He wasn't there, no. But that's Henny, Rudy, Georgie, Abby, and Richard. And that's like, and that's Harry Shannon. He used to play Cornett too, Shannon, eh? Harry, yeah. Harry Shannon, yeah. But Georgie, oh, and that's all I had. He said, well, I don't want to take it away from you. Well, he said, I'll tell you what you do. Get Papa to try, you can get a copy. I said, yeah. So he went and saw Coleman and Coleman said, yeah, he'd do. So we got one for Merritt and one for Abby and one I sent Georgie.
No, Merritt ain't there. I didn't think so. No, Merritt ain't there. No. Merritt is not on here.
